data.narrative:
ideaForge is a publicly listed Defense & Security company founded by Ankit Mehta, Ashish Bhatt, and Rahul Singh, having raised $50M+ in total capital. The valuation exercise draws from a universe of 26 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private comps including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Peer-Median triangulation is not applicable to this analysis. The target company lacks a sufficiently dense peer set when filtered by stage, adjacent-stage, and valuation tier simultaneously. While 26 Defense & Security peers exist broadly, application of narrow stage and tier criteria yielded fewer than three datapoints, the minimum threshold for meaningful median calibration. An all-sector fallback would introduce material bias and is therefore excluded from this analysis.

The scarcity of tightly comparable precedents in Defense & Security—a sector characterized by regulatory heterogeneity, long sales cycles, and concentration among well-capitalized players—limits triangulation precision. Robust valuation would benefit from additional comparable transaction or public filing data within the narrow peer band. Without sufficient quantitative anchors meeting the peer-match criteria, this analysis cannot support a single range. Further diligence on cash burn rates, contract backlog, and margin trajectory would be required to ground a defensible valuation range.
